```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, warning = FALSE, message = FALSE, dpi = 160)
source(file.path(params$root, "R", "pipeline", "frequentist_hierarchical_auc_reporting.R"))
output_dir <- params$output_dir
read_output <- function(...) readr::read_csv(file.path(output_dir, ...), show_col_types = FALSE)
audit <- read_output("tables", "data_audit.csv")
ledger <- read_output("tables", "model_robustness_ledger.csv")
climate_tests <- read_output("tables", "climate_cluster_robust_block_tests.csv")
climate_coef <- read_output("tables", "climate_coefficients.csv")
trait_ml <- read_output("tables", "trait_ML_comparisons.csv")
trait_tests <- read_output("tables", "trait_cluster_robust_block_tests.csv")
trait_reduction <- read_output("tables", "trait_species_slope_variance_reduction.csv")
horizon_summary <- read_output("tables", "horizon_comparison.csv")
paired <- read_output("tables", "horizon_paired_effects.csv")
species_effects <- read_output("tables", "species_random_effects.csv")
species_support <- read_output("tables", "species_support.csv")
influence <- read_output("diagnostics", "influential_experiments.csv")
selected_climate <- ledger |>
  dplyr::filter(.data$analysis == "climate", .data$horizon == "max", .data$selected)
selected_robust_label <- dplyr::case_when(
  selected_climate$robust_method[[1]] == "experiment_clustered_CR2" ~
    "experiment-clustered CR2",
  selected_climate$robust_method[[1]] == "experiment_clustered_CR1_fallback" ~
    "experiment-clustered CR1 with a small-sample adjustment",
  TRUE ~ selected_climate$robust_method[[1]]
)
metric <- function(horizon, name) {
  value <- audit$value[audit$horizon == horizon & audit$metric == name]
  if (length(value) != 1L) NA_real_ else value[[1]]
}
fmt <- function(x, digits = 3) {
  if (digits == 0) {
    format(round(x), scientific = FALSE, big.mark = ",", trim = TRUE)
  } else {
    formatC(x, digits = digits, format = "fg", big.mark = ",")
  }
}
palette <- auc_report_palette()
embed_png <- function(path, alt) {
  knitr::asis_output(sprintf(
    '<img src="%s" alt="%s" style="width:100%%;height:auto;"/>',
    knitr::image_uri(path), alt
  ))
}
```

.caution-note {border-left:5px solid #E69F00; background:#fff8e7; padding:0.9rem 1rem; margin:1rem 0;}

```{r key-cards, results='asis'}
climate_block <- climate_tests |>
  dplyr::filter(
    .data$horizon == "max",
    .data$block == "background climate modifies warming response"
  )
cat(sprintf(
  paste0(
    '<div class="key-grid">',
    '<div class="key-card"><div class="key-number">%s</div><div class="key-label">Resident effects at the primary horizon</div></div>',
    '<div class="key-card"><div class="key-number">%s</div><div class="key-label">Accepted species</div></div>',
    '<div class="key-card"><div class="key-number">%s</div><div class="key-label">Independent experiments</div></div>',
    '<div class="key-card"><div class="key-number">%s</div><div class="key-label">Selected climate model</div></div>',
    '<div class="key-card"><div class="key-number">%.3f</div><div class="key-label">Cluster-robust climate × warming block p</div></div>',
    '</div>'
  ),
  fmt(metric("max", "total_effect_rows"), 0), fmt(metric("max", "unique_species"), 0),
  fmt(metric("max", "experiments"), 0), selected_climate$model_id[[1]],
  climate_block$p_value[[1]]
))
```

<div class="result-note">
The primary response is continuous raw AUC in warmed plots minus origin-control AUC. Maximum duration is primary; the first three years are a sensitivity analysis. Significance-derived winner/loser categories were not used to define or filter this response.
</div>

# 1. Data audit and effective replication

The audit was completed before any covariance reconstruction or hierarchical model fitting. Although the primary dataset contains `r fmt(metric("max", "total_effect_rows"), 0)` effects, climate inference is replicated at `r fmt(metric("max", "experiments"), 0)` experiments.

```{r audit-effect, results='asis'}
embed_png(
  file.path(output_dir, "audit", "figures", "effect_and_biological_coverage.png"),
  "Pre-model response, replication, and trait-coverage audit."
)
```

*Pre-model response, replication, and trait-coverage audit.*

```{r audit-experiments, results='asis'}
embed_png(
  file.path(output_dir, "audit", "figures", "experiment_and_design_coverage.png"),
  "Experiment-level climate, duration, area, and plot-replication audit."
)
```

*Experiment-level climate, duration, area, and plot-replication audit.*

The complete standalone audit, including column mappings and validation checks, is embedded in `audit/data_audit.html` and remains available even if later model fitting fails.

# 2. Climate hierarchy

The selected primary model was `r selected_climate$model_id[[1]]`, with fixed structure `r selected_climate$formula[[1]]` and `r selected_climate$random_structure[[1]]` random effects. Its sampling-variance source was: `r selected_climate$V_type[[1]]`.

```{r climate-surfaces, fig.width=12, fig.height=8, fig.cap="Predicted resident AUC, experiment-clustered uncertainty, and warming slopes within observed three-dimensional climate support."}
surface <- read_output("predictions", "climate_surface_horizon_max.csv") |>
  dplyr::filter(.data$supported)
slopes <- read_output("predictions", "warming_slope_surface_horizon_max.csv") |>
  dplyr::filter(.data$supported)
common_surface_limit <- max(abs(surface$estimate), na.rm = TRUE)
common_slope_limit <- max(abs(slopes$estimate), na.rm = TRUE)
p_surface <- ggplot2::ggplot(surface, ggplot2::aes(.data$T_z, .data$P_z, fill = .data$estimate)) +
  ggplot2::geom_raster() +
  ggplot2::geom_contour(ggplot2::aes(z = .data$estimate), breaks = 0, colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.3) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ warming_level) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient2(low = palette$low, mid = palette$mid, high = palette$high, midpoint = 0, limits = c(-common_surface_limit, common_surface_limit)) +
  ggplot2::coord_equal() + auc_report_theme() +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "Predicted warmed-minus-origin AUC", x = "Destination temperature (SD)", y = "Log precipitation (SD)", fill = "AUC")
p_uncertainty <- ggplot2::ggplot(surface, ggplot2::aes(.data$T_z, .data$P_z, fill = .data$robust_se)) +
  ggplot2::geom_raster() + ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ warming_level) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_viridis_c(option = "C") + ggplot2::coord_equal() + auc_report_theme() +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "Experiment-clustered CR1 uncertainty", x = "Destination temperature (SD)", y = "Log precipitation (SD)", fill = "CR1 SE")
p_slopes <- ggplot2::ggplot(slopes, ggplot2::aes(.data$T_z, .data$P_z, fill = .data$estimate)) +
  ggplot2::geom_raster() +
  ggplot2::geom_contour(ggplot2::aes(z = .data$estimate), breaks = 0, colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.3) +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ warming_level) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient2(low = palette$low, mid = palette$mid, high = palette$high, midpoint = 0, limits = c(-common_slope_limit, common_slope_limit)) +
  ggplot2::coord_equal() + auc_report_theme() +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "AUC change per 1 SD warming", x = "Destination temperature (SD)", y = "Log precipitation (SD)", fill = "Slope")
patchwork::wrap_plots(p_surface, p_uncertainty, p_slopes, ncol = 1) +
  patchwork::plot_annotation(tag_levels = "A")
```

<div class="caution-note">
The joint experiment-clustered test of {T×W, P×W, T×P×W} gave F(`r climate_block$numerator_df[[1]]`, `r climate_block$denominator_df[[1]]`) = `r fmt(climate_block$statistic[[1]])`, p = `r fmt(climate_block$p_value[[1]])`. `r if (is.finite(climate_block$p_value[[1]]) && climate_block$p_value[[1]] < 0.05) "This supports climate-dependent modification of the warming response." else "This did not provide clear evidence that background climate modifies the warming response."`
</div>

# 3. Trait models: selection versus evidence

```{r trait-summary-table}
trait_summary <- ledger |>
  dplyr::filter(startsWith(.data$analysis, "trait_"), .data$selected) |>
  dplyr::transmute(
    trait = .data$trait, selected_model = .data$model_id,
    random_structure = .data$random_structure, stable = .data$stable
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    trait_ml |>
      dplyr::filter(.data$comparison == "H2 vs H3") |>
      dplyr::select(.data$trait, ML_LRT_p = .data$p_value),
    by = "trait"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    trait_tests |>
      dplyr::filter(.data$block == "trait modifies warming across joint climate context") |>
      dplyr::select(.data$trait, cluster_robust_block_p = .data$p_value),
    by = "trait"
  ) |>
  dplyr::left_join(
    trait_reduction |>
      dplyr::select(
        .data$trait,
        slope_variance_change_percent = .data$percent_reduction_residual_species_W_slope_variance
      ),
    by = "trait"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(dplyr::across(where(is.numeric), ~ signif(.x, 4)))
knitr::kable(trait_summary, caption = "H3 was selected by the prespecified stability hierarchy, not by p-value.")
```

```{r trait-effects, fig.width=12, fig.height=9, fig.cap="Estimated change in resident AUC for a +1 SD trait difference. Surfaces are descriptive model contrasts within observed climate support; inferential support is determined from the accompanying joint experiment-clustered tests."}
trait_effects <- purrr::map_dfr(c("LDMC", "LMA", "vegetative_height"), function(trait) {
  read_output("predictions", paste0("trait_plus_1SD_effect_", trait, ".csv")) |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$supported) |>
    dplyr::mutate(trait = trait)
})
trait_limit <- max(abs(trait_effects$estimate), na.rm = TRUE)
ggplot2::ggplot(trait_effects, ggplot2::aes(.data$T_z, .data$P_z, fill = .data$estimate)) +
  ggplot2::geom_raster() +
  ggplot2::geom_contour(ggplot2::aes(z = .data$estimate), breaks = 0, colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.25) +
  ggplot2::facet_grid(trait ~ warming_level) +
  ggplot2::scale_fill_gradient2(low = palette$low, mid = palette$mid, high = palette$high, midpoint = 0, limits = c(-trait_limit, trait_limit)) +
  ggplot2::coord_equal() + auc_report_theme() +
  ggplot2::labs(x = "Destination temperature (SD)", y = "Log precipitation (SD)", fill = "AUC change", title = "Effect of a +1 SD trait difference")
```

The experiment-clustered trait × warming-context block p-values were `r paste(paste0(trait_summary$trait, " = ", formatC(trait_summary$cluster_robust_block_p, digits=3, format="f")), collapse=", ")`. `r if (any(trait_summary$cluster_robust_block_p < 0.05, na.rm=TRUE)) paste("Robust block support was present for", paste(trait_summary$trait[trait_summary$cluster_robust_block_p < 0.05], collapse=", "), "; stable H3 selection alone is not the evidence criterion.") else "None supported systematic trait-dependent warming responses; retaining stable H3 models does not establish such a response."`

# 4. Species variation within observed support

```{r species-effects, fig.width=11, fig.height=8, fig.cap="Largest supported species deviations from the average intercept and warming slope. Estimates are shrunken random effects and displays require observations from at least three experiments."}
species_display <- species_effects |>
  dplyr::left_join(species_support, by = "species_id") |>
  dplyr::filter(.data$display_eligible) |>
  dplyr::group_by(.data$component) |>
  dplyr::slice_max(abs(.data$estimate), n = 18, with_ties = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::ungroup()
ggplot2::ggplot(
  species_display,
  ggplot2::aes(x = stats::reorder(.data$species_id, .data$estimate), y = .data$estimate,
               ymin = .data$conf_low, ymax = .data$conf_high)
) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey45") +
  ggplot2::geom_pointrange(colour = palette$negative) + ggplot2::coord_flip() +
  ggplot2::facet_wrap(~ component, scales = "free") + auc_report_theme() +
  ggplot2::labs(x = NULL, y = "Species deviation with 95% interval", title = "Species random effects")
```

# 5. Horizon, design, and robustness checks

```{r horizon-duration, fig.width=12, fig.height=5.5, fig.cap="Horizon agreement and the mechanical association between raw maximum-duration AUC and experimental duration."}
p_horizon <- ggplot2::ggplot(paired, ggplot2::aes(.data$auc_effect_3, .data$auc_effect_max)) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey75") + ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey75") +
  ggplot2::geom_abline(slope = 1, intercept = 0, linetype = 2) +
  ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.3, size = 0.9, colour = palette$negative) +
  ggplot2::coord_equal() + auc_report_theme() +
  ggplot2::labs(title = paste0("Maximum vs year 3 (r = ", fmt(horizon_summary$correlation[[1]]), ")"), x = "First-3-year AUC", y = "Maximum-duration AUC")
p_duration <- ggplot2::ggplot(paired, ggplot2::aes(.data$duration, .data$auc_effect_max)) +
  ggplot2::geom_hline(yintercept = 0, colour = "grey75") +
  ggplot2::geom_jitter(width = 0.08, alpha = 0.25, size = 0.8, colour = palette$negative) +
  ggplot2::geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = TRUE, colour = "grey20") + auc_report_theme() +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "Maximum AUC and duration", x = "Inclusive years", y = "Maximum-duration AUC")
patchwork::wrap_plots(p_horizon, p_duration, ncol = 2)
```

```{r influence-loeo, fig.width=12, fig.height=5.5, fig.cap="Experiment influence and leave-one-experiment-out stability for central climate coefficients."}
top_influence <- influence |>
  dplyr::slice_max(.data$sum_cooks_distance, n = 12) |>
  dplyr::mutate(experiment_id = stats::reorder(.data$experiment_id, .data$sum_cooks_distance))
p_influence <- ggplot2::ggplot(top_influence, ggplot2::aes(.data$sum_cooks_distance, .data$experiment_id)) +
  ggplot2::geom_col(fill = palette$gold) + auc_report_theme() +
  ggplot2::labs(title = "Largest experiment influence totals", x = "Summed approximate Cook distance", y = NULL)
loo_path <- file.path(output_dir, "diagnostics", "climate_LOEO_coefficients.csv")
if (file.exists(loo_path)) {
  loo <- readr::read_csv(loo_path, show_col_types = FALSE) |>
    dplyr::filter(.data$term %in% c("W_z", "T_z:W_z", "P_z:W_z", "T_z:P_z:W_z"))
  full <- climate_coef |>
    dplyr::filter(
      .data$horizon == "max", .data$model_id == selected_climate$model_id[[1]],
      startsWith(.data$inference, "experiment_clustered_"),
      .data$term %in% c("W_z", "T_z:W_z", "P_z:W_z", "T_z:P_z:W_z")
    )
  p_loo <- ggplot2::ggplot(loo, ggplot2::aes(.data$estimate, .data$term)) +
    ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, colour = "grey70") +
    ggplot2::geom_point(alpha = 0.28, size = 1, colour = palette$negative) +
    ggplot2::geom_point(data = full, colour = palette$positive, size = 2.8) +
    auc_report_theme() +
    ggplot2::labs(title = "Leave-one-experiment-out coefficients", subtitle = "Orange: full-data estimate", x = "Coefficient", y = NULL)
} else {
  p_loo <- ggplot2::ggplot() + ggplot2::annotate("text", x = 0, y = 0, label = "LOEO was skipped for this run") + ggplot2::theme_void()
}
patchwork::wrap_plots(p_influence, p_loo, ncol = 2)
```

```{r loeo-summary, results='asis'}
loo_diagnostic_paths <- c(
  file.path(output_dir, "diagnostics", "climate_LOEO_diagnostics.csv"),
  Sys.glob(file.path(output_dir, "diagnostics", "trait_LOEO_diagnostics_*.csv"))
)
if (length(loo_diagnostic_paths) && all(file.exists(loo_diagnostic_paths))) {
  loo_diagnostics <- purrr::map_dfr(loo_diagnostic_paths, readr::read_csv, show_col_types = FALSE)
  cat(sprintf(
    "%s of %s available leave-one-experiment-out refits were stable. ",
    sum(loo_diagnostics$stable), nrow(loo_diagnostics)
  ))
} else {
  cat("Leave-one-experiment-out diagnostics were skipped or are incomplete for this run. ")
}
cat("Duration-normalized and design-adjusted models remain sensitivities and do not replace the primary raw maximum-duration response.")
```
